limitations: Local preview and local Wrangler measurements, not public Cloudflare transit.
Network observations have three samples per condition and report median/min/max; no p95 claim.
Before and after network runs are on November 6 and 7, respectively; final runs explicitly emulate foreground focus.
Interaction timings include programmatic input/click, React store and pagination; not directly comparable to stage-2 runtime-only timings.
First font stabilization remains about 10.45 seconds in the specified cold slow network.
Initial account identification still gates workspace startup; no account isolation behavior was changed.
PDF/HTML engines do not promise pixel-identical layouts.
